description: This Java class demonstrates creating and handling a PopupMenu in an Android activity. It displays a popup menu when a button is clicked and shows a toast message upon menu item selection.

classes.name: PopupMenu1
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating use of PopupMenu with menu inflation and item click handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets its content view.

methods.name: onPopupButtonClick
methods.description: Creates and displays a PopupMenu anchored to the button, inflates menu items, and sets a click listener for menu items.
